lore.modestmagic.altar: The heart of all magic. Surround it with Pedestals and place an item on each, then sneak-use the Altar or power it with Flux to infuse items, enchant gear, or summon creatures.
lore.modestmagic.pedestal: A stand that holds an ingredient for an Altar ritual. Place them around an Altar.
lore.modestmagic.stardust: Glittering dust ground from a Nether Star. A magical ingredient for Altar rituals.
lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet: A blank stone tablet forged from Rose Gold and Amethyst. Infuse it at an Altar to inscribe it with enchantments.
lore.modestmagic.enchantment_tablet_aqua: An Enchantment Tablet that grants Aqua Affinity, Depth Strider, or Impaling. Apply it to gear at an Anvil to add every enchantment it can, at level one.
